content.title: About
content.content: Similac Alimentum is a hypoallergenic ready‑to‑feed infant formula designed for newborns and infants with heightened sensitivity to cow’s milk proteins. The formula features partially hydrolyzed protein, prebiotics, and essential vitamins and minerals to support growth and development in children at risk of allergy.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Similac Alimentum was one of the first hypoallergenic formulas approved by the FDA.
The product is ready to use straight from the container, no reconstitution required.
It contains the prebiotic FOS (fructooligosaccharides) to promote a healthy gut microbiome.
The formula is lactose‑free, making it suitable for infants with lactose intolerance.
Each container typically provides 8–12 days of feeding at standard intake levels.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Hypoallergenic proteins and prebiotics help develop the immune system in infants with increased sensitivity.

items.title: Optimal growth
items.content: The formula supplies all essential macro‑ and micronutrients, including DHA, ARA, iron, and zinc, needed for brain and body development.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed protein is easier to digest, reducing the risk of food‑related reactions.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: Prebiotics foster beneficial bacteria, improving digestive comfort.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for infants with lactose intolerance, minimizing gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Soy protein allergy
items.content: Although hypoallergenic, the formula may contain soy lecithin, which can trigger reactions in soy‑sensitive infants.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The product contains a small amount of maltose; consult a physician for infants with metabolic concerns.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Once opened, the formula should be used within 48 hours to prevent bacterial growth.

items.title: Not a breast‑milk substitute
items.content: Intended only as a supplement or replacement under medical guidance, not as a universal breast‑milk alternative.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve the formula at room temperature. If refrigerated, gently warm to feeding temperature; do not freeze. Shake the bottle lightly before each use to ensure uniformity. Follow pediatrician recommendations for portion sizes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 48 hours. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor, discoloration, or unusual taste.
